---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new AI use case, workflow, improvement, or project feature
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem would this feature, workflow, or use case solve?

Please describe the current situation and why an improvement is needed.

## Proposed Solution

Describe the proposed AI-assisted solution or project improvement.

Explain how it could work in practice.

## Target Users

Who would benefit from this feature or use case?

Examples:

- Public-sector professionals
- Digital transformation teams
- Trainers
- Educators
- Organizations
- Community users

## Expected Benefits

Describe the expected benefits.

Examples:

- Time savings
- Improved productivity
- Better information processing
- Improved AI literacy
- Easier knowledge sharing
- Better workflow quality

## Risks and Limitations

Describe any potential:

- Accuracy risks
- Privacy concerns
- Security concerns
- Implementation limitations
- Human oversight requirements

## Additional Context

Add any examples, references, screenshots, documents, or other information that may help explain the proposal.
